title: Create
subtitle: Make a story of your own.

ai.title: Write an AI story
ai.body: Write the opening. AI writes and draws the scenes, and you choose what happens next.
ai.priceDetail: to begin, then {{scene}} for each new scene

upload.title: Upload an episode
upload.body: Share a vertical video of up to 2 minutes.
upload.note: Anyone 18+ can upload. To earn money, apply to earn in the studio.

stopMotion.title: Make stop-motion
stopMotion.body: Capture frames with your camera and turn them into an episode.

ai.title: Allow AI to make your story
ai.body: To write and draw your story, we send what you type, and your choices, to AI models from Meta. Narration may be read by a voice model from Google, through Cloudflare. We don’t send your name or email.
ai.manage: You can change this any time in Settings.

upload.title: Allow us to process your uploads
upload.body: To check your videos and add captions and tags, we send them to AI models from Meta, which read the picture and the speech.
upload.attestation: I made this video, or I have the right to share it, and everyone in it agrees to be shown.
upload.manage: You can change this any time in Settings.

voice.title: Allow voice input
voice.body: To turn your voice into text, we send the recording to an AI model from Meta.
voice.manage: You can change this any time in Settings.
